thread_text:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — Sales pushed a pilot ask: Starter tier defaults, burst behavior, and softcap contract language. Need owners + three launch gates each.
Diego (Eng): Engineering gates: 1) perf validation: p95 under expected pilot load, 2) tenant-level burst isolation verified in staging, 3) autoscaler safety limits and graceful degradation. Do we have a safe baseline number?
Lina (RevOps): Pilot spec from Sales: baseline 50k tokens/mo, burst 200k tokens/mo (softcap), 14-day trial grace. Need to decide billing semantics for burst vs baseline.
Diego (Eng): We already emit token counters. Two approaches: gateway enforcement or post-hoc billing. I prefer enforcement to prevent huge unexpected bills.
Samir (SRE): Gateway enforcement ok if we add circuit-breaker to avoid eviction storms. Rollout: 5% low-QPS tenants → 25% → 100% with health checks at each step. Health checks: error rate <0.5%, queue depth <3, p95 delta <+30ms.
Priya (Legal): Softcap language must be framed as "expected usage". For pilots, overage auto-bill must be opt-in. Any SLA tied to tier needs a credit/refund formula — I'll draft a one-paragraph appendix.
Lina (RevOps): For pilots we'll do manual overage approval. For GA: deterministic billing. Proposal: track burst as separate metric and invoice a burst SKU.
Ava (PM): Action: produce one-pager with owners + 3 gating bullets each + billing sample. Due Friday for Sales & Legal.
Diego (Eng): I’ll own runtime gating and a sample quota YAML. Snippet: ```quota:
 tier: starter
 baseline_tokens: 50000
 burst:
  enabled: true
  burst_tokens_per_month: 200000
  enforcement: gateway
  softcap: true
  overage_sku: starter-burst-overage```
Samir (SRE): I'll own rollout and observability. Telemetry required: pricing.tier_assigned, pricing.token_usage, pricing.burst_enter, pricing.burst_exit, pricing.overage_invoiced. Add alert: tenant burst_enter >3x baseline in 1hr.
Lina (RevOps): I'll own billing schema, SKU naming, and pilot→GA migration. Question: will Sales have a self-serve toggle to enable burst?
Ava (PM): Intent is yes but gated by RevOps & Legal. Include manual override for pilots.
Priya (Legal): I’ll add a pilot clause: trial grace + explicit opt-in for auto-billing.
billing-bot: Invoice preview (preview-only): https://billing.redwood.example/pilot-preview?sku=starter-burst-overage :mag:
Ava (PM): Proposed GA success criteria: 1) billing accuracy mismatch <0.5% on pilot samples, 2) p95 latency regression containment (<25% tenants affected), 3) completed sales runbook and opt-in flow. Agree?
Diego (Eng): Agree — will add perf harness.
Lina (RevOps): Agree — will produce sample invoice and reconciliation checklist.
Samir (SRE): Agree — will prepare SLO docs and rollback playbook.
Priya (Legal): Agree — will produce clause and SLA appendix.
Ava (PM): Thanks — I’ll compile the one-pager and circulate EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
